description: This file defines multiple reusable React components and utility functions for a UI in a Next.js project. It includes components like AppShell, Card, Button, Input, Select, Table, and Badge, as well as utility functions such as classNames. The components facilitate consistent layout, styling, and interaction patterns across the application.

methods.name: classNames
methods.description: Concatenates multiple class name strings, filtering out false, undefined, or null values to produce a single string of class names.

methods.name: AppShell
methods.description: Main layout component with sidebar, top bar, and main content area.

methods.name: TopBar
methods.description: Component rendering the top navigation bar with title and links.

methods.name: NavMenu
methods.description: Navigation menu component with route links, highlighting the active route based on current path.

methods.name: Card
methods.description: A surface container component with an optional header section.

methods.name: Button
methods.description: Styled button component supporting different visual variants.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: Input field with label and optional error message.

methods.name: Select
methods.description: Dropdown select component with label and validation error display.

methods.name: Table
methods.description: Generic table component for displaying rows of data with customizable columns.

methods.name: Badge
methods.description: Colored badge component indicating status or categorization.
